name: Kirishima Shizuka
source:
Shizuka is [url=/c1501]Kouhei’s[/url] classmate who is very quiet in school and would rather read a book at lunch than socialize with other people. She also works at the resteraunt “Blau” as a waitress. However, behind her cold exterior is a cute and shy girl.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/relations-sister-x-sister-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
